At some point by [[311 BBY]], a '''star yacht''' carrying the principal [[Director/Legends|director]] of the [[Shipyard/Legends|shipyard]] company [[Kuat Drive Yards/Legends|Kuat Drive Yards]], [[Ursela Kuat]], was destroyed along the [[Rothana Route]] [[Hyperspace route/Legends|hyperlane]] by the [[Gravity mine/Legends|gravity mines]] placed there to protect the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]] KDY shipyard [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Rothana/Legends|Rothana]]. [[Standard decade/Legends|Decades]] later it was revealed that Kuat's rivals on the KDY directorate had secretly been behind the [[Yacht/Legends|yacht's]] destruction and Kuat's [[Death/Legends|death]].<ref name="TEGtW" />

==Behind the scenes==
Ursela Kuat's [[Star/Legends|star]] yacht was mentioned in the [[2012]] reference book ''[[The Essential Guide to Warfare]]'', written by [[Jason Fry]] and [[Paul R. Urquhart]].<ref name="TEGtW" />
